Project: https://github.com/sumatrapdfreader/sumatrapdf
Release source: tag 3.6.1rel

This product invokes the unmodified SumatraPDF executable as a separate process.
SumatraPDF is distributed under GNU GPL version 3; see COPYING. Additional
notices, authorship and component licenses are preserved in COPYING.BSD,
AUTHORS and the complete SumatraPDF-source.zip archive supplied here.

Corresponding source is included with this distribution in SumatraPDF-source.zip,
including build files and bundled dependency sources. It is not replaced by a
link to the upstream project. See the source archive's readme and docs for build
instructions. No SumatraPDF source modifications have been made by this project.

Do not distribute only SumatraPDF.exe. Preserve this entire resource directory.
Before publishing a release, verify the packaged binary matches the release
manifest, all source/build inputs are present, and required component notices
remain available. The preparation script does not establish legal clearance
for any other dependencies or future modifications.
